verdict.line: You lose if you tank his level 3-5 Q-E-auto combo standing still, and you win if you bank W through his all-in and punish the cooldown that follows.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane at 48.2% over 730 games because Darius's burst window (Q pull-in, E hook, empowered auto) peaks before Mordekaiser has the health and item scaling to make W (Indestructible) trade favorably. Once Mordekaiser hits his Rylai's/Riftmaker power spike, his Q (Obliterate) poke and banked shield damage close the gap back to even. The matchup is decided by who mistimes their cooldowns first, not by a structural favorite.

theirWindow.when: Level 3-5, his Q off cooldown and full HP
theirWindow.what: He can chain Q (Decimate) into an auto, E (Apprehend) pull, then another auto for a huge burst. Do not stand at max E range fighting for last hits here — give up a few CS rather than eat the full combo with your W down.

yourWindow.when: His Q whiffs or E is spent missing you
yourWindow.what: Decimate resets its cooldown only on a hit, so a whiffed Q or a wasted E pull leaves him with no engage tool for several seconds. Walk up, dump Q and E, and force a trade he can't answer.

powerCurve.note: Neither combo is online, minimal trading
W shield banks and returns his burst
Rylai's slow plus Riftmaker sustain outtrades

start.why: Doran's Shield runs a 56% win rate over 150 games and its regen-plus-block proc directly answers Darius's poke autos and Hemorrhage bleed ticks better than the more commonly picked Doran's Ring (49.3% over 740 games).

boots.why: 83.3% pick rate at a 50% win rate, and OP.GG's own tip for this matchup is to prioritize armor purchases — Steelcaps directly cuts his auto-attack and Q damage.

core.why: The slow lets you actually stick Q and E on Darius instead of letting him walk his combo in for free; this is the most-picked full path at 60% over 60 games.
Omnivamp keeps you healthy through extended trades where he's chipping you with bleed stacks.
Bonus damage against a target you're already slowing punishes him for standing in range to land his own combo.

situational.when: he is building lifesteal or you need armor plus grievous wounds to shut down his passive sustain
you are losing the early trades hard and need cheap armor with an anti-heal proc immediately
their team stacks CC or magic damage beyond just Darius
the game goes long and you need a fourth item with dual scaling instead of more flat armor

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror ramps through the exact kind of extended, multi-auto trade this lane produces, and its adaptive force plus healing offsets the damage he's dealing back with Hemorrhage stacks.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 84.7% of games at a 51.2% win rate — this is a trading lane, and Ignite lets you close out a kill right as your banked W damage releases.

playing.title: Don't poke Q into his approach
playing.detail: Obliterate has a visible wind-up; throwing it while he's closing distance just gives him a free path to trade back. Use it to zone the wave or punish him standing still, not on cooldown.

playing.title: Bank W before his combo lands
playing.detail: Pop Indestructible the instant he commits Q or E so his burst gets absorbed and returned as magic damage. Popping it late or on cooldown is how you lose these trades outright.

playing.title: Back off at 3-4 Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: Five stacks triggers his bonus bleed damage and slow — disengage before he caps it out rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed Q immediately
playing.detail: Decimate only resets on a hit, so a missed Q or a wasted E pull leaves him without an engage tool for several seconds — walk up and dump your combo.

playing.title: Play around his level 6 execute
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine scales off missing health and resets on takedown. Don't fight him under 40% HP near his tower once he hits 6.

playing.title: Use E to reset spacing
playing.detail: Death's Grasp both slows and repositions him — use it to pull him off a minion he's using for cover or to buy space when your W is down.

playing.title: Save R for a forced isolate, not lane poke
playing.detail: Realm of Death is a dueling tool, not a trading tool — hold it until you're ahead in items and want to guarantee a 1v1 he can't escape.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Purchases foremost Plated Steelcamps, Bramble Vest, and other items with armor. Maintain your distance from Darius’s (E) especially if he has Ghost.
